# Framio

> Framio is a free, MIT-licensed design canvas for coding agents. It renders React and Tailwind designs from files in a developer's repository, with element selection, responsive viewports, and pinned comments.

Framio works with Claude Code, Codex, and other agents that read `.claude/skills` or `.agents/skills`, such as OpenCode, Cursor, Grok CLI, and Antigravity. Your agent writes each screen as a React and Tailwind file, and you click elements or pin comments on the canvas to tell it what to fix. Because Framio runs inside the agent's session in the repository, the agent reads the existing code, theme, and copy before designing. It can redesign an existing page (it screenshots the running app onto a moodboard and derives DESIGN.md from the current product), design new pages that match an existing product, and build a chosen design into the app, comparing app screenshots with the design at every width. The canvas runs on localhost. It supports macOS on Apple Silicon and Linux x64 and arm64. It does not include a coding agent or model subscription.

Framio is an independent open-source project. It is not affiliated with Frame.io, Adobe's video review platform.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://framio.design/): Product overview, workflow, capabilities, and frequently asked questions.
- [Quick start and reference](https://framio.design/docs/): Installation, agent setup, commands, DESIGN.md, comments, and design comparison.
- [Documentation in Markdown](https://framio.design/docs.md): The same documentation as plain Markdown.
- [Full text](https://framio.design/llms-full.txt): Product facts and documentation in one plain-text file.
